items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: Alvin Alcorn played beautiful with Ole Manol and some.

ctx.x: Well, I think he was doing that. And he was the best around him. And at that time, he did. I think he was the best. And then Mr. Ithlap, he used to be pretty good too. Lionel Faber.
I'm trying to think about the different guys I've heard about his being good at Fennells. Alvin Alcorn played beautiful with Ole Manol and some. And Manuel Parage is supposed to have been good.

Oh, yeah. He was good. He was strong and everything. But you see, this boy, McCollum, he didn't blast nothing. But the tune came out and he said, he just as clear as anything. He didn't blast nothing. Of course, as a matter of fact, he was a strong man on the track. He didn't blast. But the other boy, McCollum, he didn't blast. I swore it to him. But you could hear it anyway. I see.
